Defensive versus industrial assets

Gold/Copper Ratio

This ratio compares the daily gold price with the copper futures price on the same calendar date. It provides a simple view of defensive demand relative to industrial-market strength.

Calculating the Gold/Copper ratio…

How to interpret the ratio

A rising Gold/Copper ratio means gold is strengthening relative to copper. This may occur when defensive demand increases or industrial expectations weaken.

A falling ratio means copper is strengthening relative to gold. This may coincide with stronger industrial expectations, but the ratio cannot establish the cause.
